title: Spring Asparagus Gratin
description: A simple and flavorful side dish that showcases the taste of fresh asparagus, topped with a crispy and zesty Canadian cheese.
instructions: Trim the ends of the asparagus and place them in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast the asparagus in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until tender.
In a separate pan, sauté the chopped spring onions until softened.
In a greased 8-inch square baking dish, create a layer of roasted asparagus.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the asparagus, followed by a layer of sautéed onions.
Grate the gratin on top and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the Spring Asparagus Gratin warm, garnished with additional spring onions if desired.
